🔎 **F-CUT-1 (attended 2026-10-09, measured during the Option B cutover) — A STATUS-ONLY EDGE PROBE READS A DEAD API AS HEALTHY.** When the daily Workers/Pages Functions cap is exhausted, Pages serves the SPA's `index.html` with HTTP 200 for `/api/stats`; `scripts/health-watch.sh` and `ops/droplet/edge-watch.sh` reported `api=200` for hours while the county's API was dark, and only the route verifier's JSON demand caught it. Corrective `api-probe-json-1` authored and queued (lane-c). **s3000 verification 08:33Z:** stats returns 200 HTML at the canonical and direct Pages URLs; sampled week-41/week-42 standings reads return valid 200 JSON, so the observed failure is specific to stats and is not evidence that every county endpoint is down. The corrective finished during closing; attended fixture cure `782f9c548` and `apj1` landing process 95225 own its remaining gates. `artifacts/s3000/live-probe.json`, `api-custody.json`.

🧹 **F-STO-1 (attended 2026-10-25; the owner: "Can you help clean up the storage needed by Gold Rush … I think Gold Rush uses 600 GB") — THE DISK HELD 1,312 GB OF GOLD RUSH, 86 GB FREE OF 3.6 TB; EVERY SCRATCH WORKTREE CARRIES THE 9–11 GB TRACKED `artifacts/` TREE, SO CHECKOUTS WERE THE MULTIPLIER. Group A (regenerable scratch, no history) removed on the owner's "clean A": 30 merged sibling worktrees `~/Claude/Projects/wt-*` (~300 GB), 21 fire/attended arena checkouts under `~/.goldrush/` (their logs kept), the `land/wt-preview-pub` rsync staging copy (86 GB), four re-land clones in `~/.goldrush/repair` whose tips equal the `candidate/*` branches on GitHub (53 GB; commit maps kept), two old gate worktrees in the primary, eight orphan lane copies inside the history clone whose `.git` files pointed at the primary's live lanes (their 94 untracked unique files, 354 MB of July marketing reels and raw media, archived first to `~/.goldrush/archive/history-local-worktrees-untracked-2026-10-25/`), the stray `Gold%20Rush` folder. Every removal through `git worktree remove` after a merged-branch check and an evidence-only dirt check; 14 items the checks held back were examined by hand (stale checkouts: files equal to blobs of 2026-09-20 / 2026-07-05 commits; a gate worktree whose edits equal main's; control arenas differing only in the pilots symlink) and removed in a second pass. Result: free 86 GB → 782 GB.
